items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Lanoue was on piano. Conrad. Conrad, yeah. I didn't know him too well, but I know him.

ctx.x: You can't buy those records anymore? Yeah, I got something along by my house, I think. Yeah? I think, I believe. I think, yeah. Well, who was in Wingy's band?

He had a colored bass player. He didn't use Pop Fortier. He was a colored bass player. And he was a dealer. What's his name? A piano player. A white piano player. A raw or something. Lanoue. Lanoue. Lanoue. Lanoue. Lanoue. Yeah. What's that company of his first name? Lanoue was on piano. Conrad. Conrad, yeah. I didn't know him too well, but I know him. Conrad and... Let's see, he didn't have a big one on the trombone, did he?
No, I don't think he had a trombone.
